verdict.rationale: Wise documents global payments in 40+ currencies from a multi-currency account that can convert and fund single or batch transfers. Fee transparency is supported by claims of no hidden fees or markups and a rate lock that guarantees exactly what the recipient will get. missing for 10: a detailed documented fee breakdown or fee schedule shown before sending, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fee transparency.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send international payments in local currencies with transparent fees

citations.quote: Make payments and get paid in 40+ currencies.
enables users to hold, convert, and fund transfers (single or batches) with balances in up to 56 currencies
Lock in exactly what your recipient will get for up to 24 hours.
Pay and withdraw cash worldwide without any hidden fees or markups.
Send payments globally, in under 20 seconds
